name: command_expression
description: Command expression with optional in, timeout, background modifiers
input:
task test_cmd
  do
    result = command "shell command here"
    result = command "shell command" in "/working/dir"
    result = command "shell command" timeout 60s
    result = command "shell command" in "/dir" timeout 60s
    handle = command "shell command" background true timeout 30m
